notable_absence.finding: No Enterprise/Community edition badges appear on this page despite extensive version-gating prose - every gate found here is expressed as a server-version-string citation (7.6.6+, 4.0+, 7.2.2+, 8.0+) rather than an edition badge, consistent with this being the second known recurring anomaly rather than a new one.

cross_component_finding: This page is the definitive answer to the batch hypothesis on the PROCEDURAL side: every access-control gate on XDCR setup and management is expressed using pre-existing vocabulary - capella-role:project-owner for the management-plane actions, and capella:cluster-access-credential (the same credential entity used for Data Service/Query Service access) for the replication's own remote-cluster authentication. XDCR does not mint its own role or credential concept anywhere on this page; the only genuinely new vocabulary is topology/filtering/status-lifecycle terms (replication filter, replication status enum, Cross Cluster Versioning), none of which are access-control primitives.
